description: A one-pole highpass and a one-pole lowpass in series, both linear and both with a CV input, for taking the extremes off a signal

params.text: Sets the highpass corner, 5Hz at fully counter-clockwise to 22kHz at fully clockwise
Sets the lowpass corner, 5Hz at fully counter-clockwise to 22kHz at fully clockwise

inputs.text: Added to the highpass knob at a tenth of the knob's full travel per volt, which is about 1.2 octaves
Added to the lowpass knob at a tenth of the knob's full travel per volt, which is about 1.2 octaves
The audio to filter; its channel count sets the polyphony of the module

outputs.text: The audio after the highpass and then the lowpass

notes: the highpass comes first and the lowpass takes its output, so the two corners crossing over leaves nothing
the CV jacks are read at a divided rate rather than every sample, so they are for slow movement rather than audio-rate modulation
